changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla course_evaluators: instructores asignados como evaluadores de un curso sin ser su dueño (reemplaza el rol evaluator); un trigger impide asignar al dueño. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría course_evaluators_audit y el trigger course_evaluators_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Instructors assigned as evaluators of a course without owning it (replaces the evaluator role, DEF-24)

column.name: course_id
column.remarks: Course the evaluator is assigned to

column.name: user_id
column.remarks: Instructor assigned as evaluator; cannot be the course owner

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER course_evaluators_not_owner_trg BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON course_evaluators FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION course_evaluators_check_not_owner()
CREATE TRIGGER course_evaluators_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON course_evaluators FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in course_evaluators

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE course_evaluators_audit ADD CONSTRAINT course_evaluators_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER course_evaluators_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON course_evaluators FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS course_evaluators_check_not_owner() CASCADE
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS course_evaluators_audit_trg ON course_evaluators
